'''2024 Eclipse Major''' was a Players Committee major event in Indianapolis, Indiana, 5–7 April 2024. [[Sam Tashima]] finished 1st in Day 2.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2024-04-eclipse-major-indianapolis-indiana-apr-5-7/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' Indianapolis, Indiana
* '''Dates:''' 5–7 April 2024
* '''GEMP importable decks:''' [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=84424 forum]
